messages:
emma (partnerships): FYI — AcmeCloud portal just rejected our PO upload. Error says 'invoice_schema: missing required field billing_address.tax_id' :eyes:
raj (deal-desk): Ugh. Do we have tax_id on file for the entity? I thought procurement uses the company EIN but not in the PO payload.
sophia (finance): We have EIN in Zendesk for billing, but the marketplace requires it in the PO JSON under billing_address.tax_id. Our export doesn't include that.
mike (legal): Any chance this is a contract-side issue? Is the PO generator stripping fields because of payment_terms mapping?
olga (marketplace-ops): Portal returned this payload error when I tried to POST the PO endpoint: 400 Bad Request {"error":"invoice_schema","details":"billing_address.tax_id: required"} — copying raw response below:
```
HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "invoice_schema",
  "details": "billing_address.tax_id: required"
}
```
vendor_john (acmecloud): Sorry about the disruption — our new portal release started enforcing tax_id for marketplace POs (regional compliance). We'll open an internal ticket but can accept a temporary manual workaround: attach a supplemental invoice with tax_id and we'll process.
emma (partnerships): Manual workaround ok short-term but we need a durable fix. Is the portal enforcement global or just certain sellers/regions?
vendor_john (acmecloud): It's global for new marketplace flow. Our product team can turn off enforcement per-seller but that'll take 1 business day and approval.
raj (deal-desk): Action items: 1) Finance provide updated PO with billing_address.tax_id included; 2) Legal confirm redlines aren't impacted; 3) Vendor to confirm portal toggle or accept manual invoice. Sophia, can you craft the revised PO now?
sophia (finance): I can generate a revised PO. Need the exact JSON structure they expect — can someone paste the schema snippet?
olga (marketplace-ops): They expect billing_address like: ```{"line1":"...","city":"...","country":"US","tax_id":"<EIN or VAT>"}```. Also note field name is tax_id (snake_case).
mike (legal): Contract redline check: if we put tax_id on the PO, it doesn't change T&Cs. However vendor contract has a clause referencing invoice details; we should keep a copy of the original SOW attach for audit trail. Recommend adding: "Invoice will include tax identifier used for remittance."
sophia (finance): OK I'll produce the corrected PO with tax_id and retain the old copy. Uploading now to the portal with vendor_john's guidance.
invoice-bot: PO 2026-ACM-00079 uploaded by sophia (finance) — processing...
invoice-bot: PO 2026-ACM-00079 processing failed: billing_address.tax_id format invalid (expected numeric or alphanumeric w/ country prefix)
sophia (finance): Format issue — what format do they want? Examples?
vendor_john (acmecloud): For US sellers: EIN without dashes (e.g., 123456789). For EU: VAT with country prefix (GB123456789). I'll patch the portal to accept dashes but that will take a day.
raj (deal-desk): For immediate processing, can vendor accept supplemental invoice in portal notes while they enable dashes? That avoids delaying provisioning.
vendor_john (acmecloud): Yes — if you add a PO comment with the tax_id and attach a PDF invoice containing tax_id, we can manually approve provisioning today.
emma (partnerships): Great. Sophia, please add the PDF and comment. Mike — confirm we keep the redline record.
mike (legal): I'll mark the contract as unchanged but will save the PO diff and the supplemental invoice for compliance. Fine to proceed.
sophia (finance): Done — uploaded PDF invoice with EIN (123456789) to PO 2026-ACM-00079 and added comment "suppl_invoice_tax_id:123456789". Reattempting processing.
invoice-bot: PO 2026-ACM-00079 manual review queued. Estimated approval 2 hours.
emma (partnerships): Thanks everyone. I'll follow up with vendor_john to get ETA on the portal toggle and request a stable schema doc so our PO generator can be patched. :thumbsup:
vendor_john (acmecloud): Will follow up by EOD with schema doc and a ticket number for the enforcement toggle. Sorry again for the friction.
raj (deal-desk): I'll update the marketplace deal checklist to include billing_address.tax_id and formatting rules so this doesn't surprise future POs.
olga (marketplace-ops): Also adding a quick validation step in our internal upload tool to surface tax_id format errors before hitting vendor portal.
emma (partnerships): Filing this as an escalation for the deal desk — putting the owner as raj. If manual approvals exceed SLA, escalate to vendor AM. :eyes:
